construction: x = mean annual contract value (APY) of the players actually on the field for the home side, minus the same for the away side, per game. y = home_win. Team attribution comes from the pre-2025 season roster; contract value comes from deals signed in 2025 or earlier. The 2025 holdout was never used to build either.
why_now: Previously unmeasurable: only 2023-2025 were roster-joinable, leaving two training seasons. The validated crosswalk makes 2018-2024 joinable, giving seven.
